basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old electrical engineering student from Karachi, Pakistan. My journey into electronics started in my first year of university, and I've been fascinated ever since. I love tinkering with DIY electronics projects and am currently diving into cryptocurrency and blockchain technology, which explains my frequent visits to EthereumMax. Besides tech, I have a sweet tooth and enjoy baking, often sharing my creations on MoonBud. My typical online hours are late at night, usually between 10 PM and 2 AM local time, as I juggle university assignments and part-time work as a barista. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time learning new skills or catching up on tech trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Currently in the third year of an electrical engineering program, I have a foundational understanding of electronics, which is constantly being expanded through coursework and personal projects. My understanding of blockchain and cryptocurrencies is mostly self-taught, fueled by online resources and discussions on forums like EthereumMax.
